title: Void Bulb
summary: Throw to deal 1 Force and pull nearby targets toward the impact point.

fields.Throw: Action, single use, up to 60 ft. Creatures and objects in a 20 ft radius can be pulled toward the impact. Creatures make a DC 18 Strength save to avoid the pull. The blast deals 1 Force damage. The pinned source reports that striking the bulb with an attack can multiply the Force damage through damage riders.
fields.Acquisition: Nautiloid, Gnat in Shattered Sanctum, or Omeluum in Ebonlake Grotto. No alchemy recipe.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
